text:
Maya Patel: handing off now, summary below. Primaries for next 12h: Raj (primary), Sam (secondary). I'm reachable for 30m if anything urgent.

Maya Patel: incidents open right now:
- INC-8921: embeddings latency spike in eu-west-1 (currently mitigated, degraded but serving).
- INC-8930: billing connector flakiness, some customers seeing 502s during bursts.

Maya Patel: what we did in last 2h:
- For INC-8921 I rolled the serving pool to a smaller quantized model variant (q4_0) which dropped tail latency but increased token cost ~5%.
- Enabled prefix KV caching for high-volume tenants (config: /infra/runbooks/kv-cache-toggle).
- For INC-8930 we added a short retry wrapper at the API gateway and increased connector timeout to 15s.

Maya Patel: customer impact:
- A handful of enterprise customers (acct ids: C-1034, C-1182) saw slowed embeddings; no data loss. Current customer-facing degradations logged to the status page incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/8921.
- Billing connector 502s affected background billing jobs; some invoices delayed.

Maya Patel: action items I created before leaving:
- TICKET-4576: follow-up perf profiling for embeddings model on eu-west-1 (assigned to Raj, due EOD tomorrow).
- TICKET-4577: investigate billing connector race condition and add end-to-end test (assigned Dustin, no ETA yet).

Raj Chen: thanks Maya — copying notes. Quick q: did you disable autoscaling on the eu-west pool when you rolled to q4_0?

Maya Patel: nope, autoscaling remained ON but with min_instances bumped to 2 for the pool to avoid cold starts.

Sam Ortiz: FYI I left a short checklist in the runbook under eng-runbooks/embeddings/eu-west.md — includes the perf command I used: 
```
/infra/bench --model redwood-v1-q4_0 --region eu-west-1 --trace /tmp/trace.out
```

Sam Ortiz: also pinned the fallback policy to redwood-v1-int8 for low-cost burst fallback.

incident-bot: ALERT: new page INC-8942 at 2212350200 — proxy 5xx spike in us-central during deploy. Severity: P2.

Maya Patel: I just saw the bot — that page started right as I left. Raj, Sam — you two please coordinate on primary/secondary for that one.

Raj Chen: taking INC-8942 as primary. Initial check: looks like deploy-bot shipped a gateway change at 2212349800. Will rollback if errors persist.

deploy-bot: deploy: gateway-service v2.13.4 -> v2.13.5 at 2212349800 by CI (sha: a1b2c3). CI notes: "optimize header parsing".

Raj Chen: rollback queued to canary (command run):
```
infractl rollback gateway-service --to v2.13.4 --canary
```

Sam Ortiz: I'll monitor logs and tail 504s. If rollback doesn't help, we'll throttle requests with the rate-limiter at edge.

Elena Gomez: scheduling a short retro tomorrow 10:00am PT to cover both billing connector and embeddings latency. I'll create calendar invite and link a doc. Attendees: Maya, Raj, Sam, Dustin, infra lead.

Dustin Blake: noted TICKET-4577 assigned to me. I'll start by reproducing billing connector in staging — dropping a note in the ticket with first reproducible step by EOD.

Raj Chen: update 2212351000 — canary rollback started, errors trending down in canary, will promote if stable for 10 min.

Raj Chen: update 2212351400 — promoted rollback to 100%. 5xx rate returned to baseline. Marking INC-8942 as resolved and archiving logs to /var/logs/incidents/8942-rollback.log

Maya Patel: thanks team. Post-handoff follow-ups for incoming:
- Raj: own INC-8921 ticket work and verify perf improvements across sizes (TICKET-4576).
- Sam: add automated e2e check for fallback policy and KV cache toggles (small PR ok).
- Dustin: start TICKET-4577 repro and propose a test + fix.
- Elena: run the retro and draft action items doc.

Maya Patel: handoff complete, handing pager to Raj. Good luck y'all :thumbsup:

Raj Chen: taking pager. Will DM if anything big comes up.

Elena Gomez: I've created retro doc: https://docs.redwood.example/retros/2026-03-16-embeddings-billing. Calendar invite sent.

Dustin Blake: filed a small follow-up task TICKET-4578 to add logging keys for billing connector (linked from 4577).

Sam Ortiz: quick note — if you need the perf traces they are in S3: s3://redwood-perf/traces/2212349*.zip

Maya Patel: signing off now. Thanks all.
